rebuttals.description: Exactly one entry per finding in the OTHER engine's report. Every finding must be answered - silence is not a position.

finding_id.description: The other report's finding id (F1, F2, ...).

stance.description: AGREE = real defect at the stated severity. PARTIAL = real but severity or root cause is wrong. REJECT = not a defect.

reason.description: One sentence. For REJECT this must state why the code is actually correct, not merely that you would have written it differently.

evidence.description: <=1 line of code-level evidence for the stance. A stance with no evidence is dropped by the arbiter, whichever side made it.

disposition.description: What should happen to the finding. needs-probe = neither side can settle it by reading; name the probe in counter_fix.

fix_agreement.description: Whether you would fix it the same way the other engine proposed.

counter_fix.description: If fix_agreement is 'different', the fix you would apply instead and why it is the root-cause fix. If disposition is 'needs-probe', the exact probe (command, grep, breakpoint) that settles it. Otherwise empty.

missed_by_other.description: At most 3 lines: BLOCK-level defects the other report missed entirely, in the same [severity] file:line - claim - evidence shape. Empty if none.
